label: Security Audit
description: Review a large codebase for vulnerabilities, leaked secrets and unsafe calls

label: Refactoring Planner
description: Plan a phased refactor from the import graph, cycles and coupling

label: Documentation Generator
description: Generate module and API documentation for a large codebase

label: Memory Manager
description: Record requests and responses in a compact graph and recall them later

label: Token Saver
description: Keep responses short: no filler, diff-only edits, dense technical prose

label: Stack Auditor
description: Check configuration, Docker and service boundaries for errors and secret leaks

label: Trust Layer Validator
description: Review decentralized identity, credential schemas and protocol handlers

label: Code Review
description: Review a branch or pull request for correctness, security, tests and maintainability

label: Dependency Audit
description: Check lock files and manifests for vulnerable, outdated, unmaintained or duplicated packages

label: Test Gap Analysis
description: Find untested behaviour, weak assertions and risky code paths in a large codebase

label: Migration Planner
description: Plan a framework, language or major-version migration with risk and rollback steps

label: Log Triage
description: Cluster errors in large log files and trace likely root causes

label: Release Notes
description: Write release notes from commits and pull requests, grouped by impact

label: Threat Model
description: Model threats with STRIDE: data flows, trust boundaries, controls with evidence, and gaps

label: API Contract Review
description: Find breaking changes and schema drift in OpenAPI, protobuf and GraphQL contracts

label: Privacy Review
description: Map where personal data is collected, stored, logged, shared and retained in a large codebase

label: CI/CD Pipeline Review
description: Check pipelines for secret exposure, excessive permissions, unpinned actions and unsafe deployments

label: Incident Postmortem
description: Write a blameless postmortem with a sourced timeline, root cause, and owned action items

label: Compliance Control Check
description: Show which compliance controls have evidence in the repository, and which need evidence from outside it

label: Audit Evidence Collector
description: Index change, review, pipeline and scan evidence for an audit period, with a hash for each item

label: License Attribution
description: Check dependency licences against a policy and draft the attribution (NOTICE) content

label: LLM App Review
description: Review a large codebase that calls language models, using Recursive Language Model (RLM) decomposition: prompt injection paths, unsafe handling of model output, over-privileged tools, and secrets or personal data sent to models, mapped to the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications. Use when an application calls an LLM API or runs an agent with tools, before release or after adding a model feature.

label: Performance Review
description: Find performance risks in a large codebase using Recursive Language Model (RLM) decomposition: queries in loops (N+1), blocking calls on async paths, unbounded reads, quadratic work and missing timeouts, ranked by how hot the path is. Use when a service is slow, before a load increase, or when asked where the code will not scale.

label: DB Migration Safety
description: Review database schema migrations before they run in production: table locks and rewrites, destructive or irreversible changes, unsafe backfills, and deploy-order breakage between code and schema. Use when a branch or pull request adds or changes a migration file.

label: Modern CSS and Layout
description: Review and write modern CSS: container queries, :has(), cascade layers, intrinsic and fluid sizing, logical properties, typography, colour, dark mode and scrollbars, with feature detection for the project's browser targets. Use when writing or reviewing stylesheets, fixing layout bugs, or replacing JavaScript layout code with CSS.

label: Forms and Autofill
description: Review and build web forms that browsers and password managers can fill: autocomplete tokens, input types, labels, validation and error feedback, one-time codes, IME-safe submit, and customizable form controls. Use when building or reviewing sign-in, sign-up, checkout, address or any data-entry form.

label: Accessibility Audit
description: Audit a large front end for accessibility using Recursive Language Model (RLM) decomposition: semantics, names, keyboard and focus, live announcements, contrast, motion, text scaling and reflow, each finding tied to a WCAG 2.2 success criterion. Use when asked for an accessibility review, before release, or when a user reports an assistive-technology problem.

label: Browser Extension Review
description: Review and build Manifest V3 browser extensions: service worker lifecycle, permissions, messaging and sender checks, content-script safety, content security policy, storage, and store-review readiness. Use when writing, reviewing or preparing to publish a Chrome or Chromium browser extension.

label: Web Performance
description: Review and improve front-end loading and responsiveness against Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS): resource priority, images and fonts, script loading, long tasks and scheduling, rendering work, navigation speed and analytics beacons. Use when a page is slow to load or respond, when Core Web Vitals fail, or before shipping a heavy front-end change.

label: Web Client Security
description: Review and build browser-side security: passkeys with WebAuthn, content security policy, Trusted Types and HTML sanitizing, subresource integrity, cross-origin messaging, outbound-connection limits, browser cryptography, and client-side privacy. Use when adding sign-in or passkeys, rendering untrusted HTML, embedding third-party scripts, or reviewing front-end security.

label: Web UI Components and Motion
description: Review and build interactive UI with platform features before custom JavaScript: dialogs, popovers, menus, tabs, accordions, tooltips, toasts, carousels, anchor positioning, view transitions, scroll-driven effects and drag, each keyboard- and screen-reader-ready and respectful of reduced motion. Use when building or reviewing UI components, animations or scroll effects.

label: Built-in AI and Agent-Ready Pages
description: Review and build features that use on-device browser AI (prompt, summarize, translate, detect language) and pages that expose tools to browser agents, with availability checks, download handling, fallbacks and safe handling of model output. Use when adding a browser AI feature, or making a site usable by AI agents.

label: Web App Platform
description: Review and build installable, offline-capable web apps and correct time and locale handling: web app manifest and install flow, service worker caching and updates, origin migration, Intl formatting, calendars, time zones and precise timestamps. Use when making a site installable or offline-capable, moving it to a new origin, or fixing date, time or locale bugs.

label: Risk management rulebook
description: Rulebook for risk in every domain: the process, scoring, register format, escalation, review cadence, domain terms and guardrails. Use when designing or reviewing any domain skill, or when a risk must be scored or escalated.

label: Safety risk: hazards and incidents
description: Hazard identification, safety observations, incident and near-miss records, safety statistics and lockout review. Use when assessing a workplace hazard, reviewing an incident or preparing safety statistics.

label: Risk register
description: Maintains a risk register in the shared format, with owners, ratings, responses and review dates. Use when a risk review is due or a new risk must be recorded.

label: Procurement cycle
description: Sourcing, purchase order, goods receipt, invoice matching and supplier onboarding, checked against the buying policy. Use when reviewing a purchase, a supplier onboarding or the monthly spend cycle.

label: Quality method: nonconformance and CAPA
description: Shared quality method: nonconformance, corrective and preventive action, and audit findings, using each domain's own terms. Use when recording a nonconformance, planning a CAPA or answering an audit finding.

label: Standards map
description: Index of the standards each domain uses, with edition and clause, checked before a skill cites them. Use when a skill cites a standard, or when an edition may have changed.

label: Campaign monitoring
description: Daily check of live campaigns: spend pacing, performance and anomalies against plan, with the day-on-day change. Use when a campaign is live and its spend or results need a daily check.

label: Weekly marketing performance
description: Weekly leads, cost per lead and return by channel, with the week-on-week change. Use when preparing the weekly marketing review.

label: Content calendar status
description: Scheduled content, late items and items waiting for approval. Use when checking the content calendar for gaps or delays.

label: Monthly marketing report
description: Monthly marketing pack with the month-on-month change. Use when preparing the monthly marketing report.

label: Marketing spend reconciliation
description: Marketing spend against budget and against supplier invoices. Use when reconciling marketing spend for a month.

label: Lead quality
description: Lead-to-opportunity conversion and rejected leads, by source. Use when judging which lead sources produce real opportunities.

label: Quarterly marketing review
description: Review of last quarter's marketing results and the plan for next quarter. Use when running the quarterly marketing review.

label: Attribution review
description: Checks the attribution model, its limits and what it can and cannot show. Use when choosing or reviewing how marketing results are credited to channels.

label: Brand health

label: Marketing annual plan
description: Campaign plan, channels and targets for next year. Use when planning marketing for next year.

label: Marketing year-to-date report

label: Marketing budget

label: Campaign brief

label: Campaign proposal

label: Advertising and consent compliance checklist
description: Checklist of campaign claims, consent and channel rules, flagged for counsel. Use when a campaign makes a claim, uses personal data or runs on a new channel.

label: Marketing request triage
description: Intake, priority, owner and deadline for unplanned marketing requests. Use when an unplanned marketing request arrives.

label: Weekly negotiation status

label: Contract renewal calendar

label: Quarterly negotiation plan, next quarter

label: Contract portfolio review

label: Annual sourcing and negotiation strategy

label: Negotiation year-to-date report
description: Year-to-date savings and value against target. Use when reporting negotiation results for the year so far.

label: Negotiation budget impact

label: Negotiation preparation brief

label: Request for proposal response

label: Negotiation request triage
description: Intake, priority, owner and deadline for unplanned negotiation requests. Use when an unplanned negotiation request arrives.

label: Quality request triage
description: Intake, priority, owner and deadline for unplanned quality requests. Use when an unplanned quality request arrives.

label: Permit-to-work register

label: Occupational health surveillance results

label: EHS certification readiness check

label: Environmental incident record
description: Records a spill, release or emission event: containment, reporting duty and actions. Use when an environmental incident occurs and needs a record.

label: Emergency response plan check

label: EHS investment business case

label: EHS request triage
description: Intake, priority, owner and deadline for unplanned EHS requests. Use when an unplanned EHS request arrives.

label: Customer queue monitor

label: Customer case backlog
description: Reports open customer cases by age and priority each day, with the day-on-day change. Use when reviewing the open case backlog each day.

label: Customer support shift handover
description: Records open cases, promises made to customers and escalations for the next shift. Use when handing over a support shift.

label: Customer service level report
description: Reports first response and resolution times against target each week, with the week-on-week change. Use when preparing the weekly service level review.

label: Customer escalation review

label: Customer satisfaction report
description: Reports customer satisfaction and NPS by channel each month, aggregated, with the month-on-month change. Use when preparing the monthly satisfaction report.

label: Top customer contact reasons

label: Knowledge base gaps

label: Interaction quality assurance
description: Scores a sample of customer interactions against the quality form each quarter. Use when running the quarterly quality assurance sample.

label: Customer service quarterly review, previous quarter
description: Reviews last quarter's service results and drafts the plan for next quarter. Use when running the quarterly customer service review.

label: Service channel review
description: Reviews the channel mix, cost per contact and customer preference each half-year. Use when reviewing which support channels to offer.

label: Customer service annual plan
description: Drafts next year's service plan: channels, service levels and resourcing. Use when planning customer service for next year.

label: Customer service year-to-date report
description: Reports year-to-date service levels and satisfaction against plan. Use when reporting customer service performance for the year so far.

label: Customer service staffing model
description: Calculates the staff needed for forecast volume and the service level, with the assumptions shown. Use when planning customer service staffing.

label: Customer complaint record
description: Records a formal customer complaint: facts, response, outcome and follow-up. Use when a formal complaint is received and must be recorded.

label: Refund or credit request check
description: Checks a refund or credit request against the approval path and the limit. Use when a refund or credit request needs a check before approval.

label: Customer support request triage
description: Intake, priority, owner and deadline for unplanned customer support requests. Use when an unplanned customer support request arrives.

label: Contract review intake
description: Triages new requests for contract review each day by type and urgency. Use when new contract review requests arrive.

label: Legal deadline watch
description: Lists notice periods, expiries and statutory deadlines due in the next thirty days. Use when checking legal deadlines each day.

label: Legal matters weekly status
description: Reports open legal matters and contracts in review each week, with status and owner. Use when preparing the weekly legal status.

label: Contract obligations tracker
description: Tracks obligations under signed contracts each month: who must do what, and by when. Use when checking contract obligations each month.

label: Disputes and claims log
description: Reports disputes and claims each month, with exposure and status. Use when reviewing the disputes and claims log.

label: External counsel spend
description: Checks external counsel fees each month against budget and by matter. Use when reviewing external legal spend.

label: Legal risk review, previous quarter
description: Reviews legal risks in the risk register against last quarter's changes. Use when running the quarterly legal risk review.

label: Policy and regulatory change tracker
description: Tracks changes to policy and law that the organisation must follow, each quarter. Use when reviewing policy and regulatory changes.

label: Contract portfolio completeness audit
description: Checks the contract portfolio for missing signatures, unsigned copies and non-standard terms each half-year. Use when auditing the contract portfolio.

label: Legal team annual plan
description: Drafts next year's legal work plan and resourcing from this year's matters. Use when planning the legal team's work for next year.

label: Legal year-to-date report
description: Reports year-to-date legal matters, spend and outcomes against plan. Use when reporting the legal team's year so far.

label: Policy and regulatory review calendar
description: Lists the review dates for policies and the regulatory reviews due each year. Use when planning the annual policy and regulatory review calendar.

label: Contract first draft from template

label: Legal clause checklist

label: NDA checklist

label: Dispute summary for counsel

label: Legal request triage

label: Sales activity log check

label: Weekly pipeline report

label: Forecast call preparation

label: Quota attainment
